title: Eye of the Night
summary: Using the spatial severance of the Fang of Abyss and All-Spectrum vision of the Eye of the Night, Ha-Jun dismantles Grand Inquisitor Belial's illusions, liberating his brother Tae-Jun.

panels.shot: belial laughing as rotunda fills with mirror illusions
panels.action: Belial laughs melodically; thirty identical mirror illusions of him materialize across the balcony tiers.
panels.prose_en: Belial laughs melodically; thirty identical mirror illusions of him materialize across the balcony tiers.
panels.prose_hi: Beleal madhurta se hansta hai; uske tees samaan darpan bhram balcony ke staron par sakar hote han.

panels.shot: belial illusions chanting in unison
panels.action: All thirty avatars chant in high-pitch demonic frequency: 'Which one is real, mortal whelp?!'

dialogue.speaker: belial
dialogue.text: Meri shadows mein tumhara har strike empty air ko kaatega!

panels.prose_en: All thirty avatars chant in high-pitch demonic frequency: 'Which one is real, mortal whelp?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Sabhi tees avtar uchch swar wali shaitani demonic aavritti mein jap karte han: 'kaun sa vastavik hai, nashwar baccha?!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun activating eye of the night in full power
panels.action: Ha-Jun's right cosmic eye pulses with brilliant violet starlight, piercing straight through the illusion mesh.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's right cosmic eye pulses with brilliant violet starlight, piercing straight through the illusion mesh.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki dahini brahmandiya aankh shandar baingani taron ki roshni ke saath spandit hoti hai, jo sidhe bhram jaal ko bhedati hai.

panels.shot: what the eye sees: true soul signature exposed
panels.action: Twenty-nine illusions appear as empty grey glass; the real Belial on the upper third balcony glows with dark purple soul flame.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Third balcony... Left pillar ke peeche. Tumhara soul flame chhip nahi sakta!

panels.prose_en: Twenty-nine illusions appear as empty grey glass; the real Belial on the upper third balcony glows with dark purple soul flame.
panels.prose_hi: Untis bhram khali bhure kaanch ke roop mein prakat hote han; upari teesri balcony par asli beleal gahre baingani rang ki aatma ki lau se chamakta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun unfurling sovereign shadow wings
panels.action: Ha-Jun's 12-foot obsidian shadow wings burst outward, blasting a sonic shockwave through the rotunda.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's 12-foot obsidian shadow wings burst outward, blasting a sonic shockwave through the rotunda.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke 12 foot ke obsidian chhaya pankh bahar ki or fute, jisse rotunda ke madhyam se ek dhwani shockwev ka visfot hua.

panels.shot: rocket ascent straight at the third balcony
panels.action: Ha-Jun rockets skyward like an anti-aircraft missile, ignoring all twenty-nine illusions.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun rockets skyward like an anti-aircraft missile, ignoring all twenty-nine illusions.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun sabhi untees bhramon ko najarandaj karte hue ek viman bhedi missile ki tarah aakash ki or rocket karta hai.

panels.shot: real belial eyes widening in panicked shock
panels.action: The real Belial stumbles back from behind the pillar, his porcelain face freezing in horror: 'HOW?!'

dialogue.speaker: belial
dialogue.text: Tumhe mera asli location kaise pata chala?! That's impossible!!

panels.prose_en: The real Belial stumbles back from behind the pillar, his porcelain face freezing in horror: 'HOW?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Asli beleal khambhe ke peeche se ladkhadata hua wapas aata hai, uska chini mitti ka chehra bhay se thithur jata hai: 'kaise?!'.

panels.shot: belial whipping chains of ruin defensively
panels.action: Belial whips the heavy black Chains of Ruin, attempting to entangle Ha-Jun in midair with gravity binds.
panels.prose_en: Belial whips the heavy black Chains of Ruin, attempting to entangle Ha-Jun in midair with gravity binds.
panels.prose_hi: Beleal ruin ki bhari kali janjeeron ko kode maarta hai, Ha-Jun ko beech hawa mein gurutvakarshan bandhanon se uljhaane ka prayas karta hai.

panels.shot: gravity field pulling ha-jun down with 10x force
panels.action: Ten times normal gravity slams into Ha-Jun's frame, threatening to smash him into the stone floor.
panels.prose_en: Ten times normal gravity slams into Ha-Jun's frame, threatening to smash him into the stone floor.
panels.prose_hi: Das guna samanya gurutvakarshan Ha-Jun ke frame se takrata hai, jisse use patthar ke farsh par kuchalne ka khatra hota hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun slashing empty air with fang of abyss
panels.action: Mid-fall, Ha-Jun slashes the void dagger directly across the invisible gravitational tether.
panels.prose_en: Mid-fall, Ha-Jun slashes the void dagger directly across the invisible gravitational tether.
panels.prose_hi: Madhya patjhad men, Ha-Jun shunya khanjar ko sidhe adrishya gurutvakarshan bandhan par kaatata hai.

panels.shot: gravity tether severed like a string
panels.action: The gravitational field snaps with a glassy chime, instantly freeing Ha-Jun from the crushing weight.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: The Fang of Abyss... Physical cheezein hi nahi, abstract concepts ko bhi cut karta hai!

panels.prose_en: The gravitational field snaps with a glassy chime, instantly freeing Ha-Jun from the crushing weight.
panels.prose_hi: Gurutvakarshan kshetra ek kaanch ki jhankar ke saath tadakta hai, turant Ha-Jun ko kuchalne wale vajan se mukt kar deta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun propelling forward off falling chain
panels.action: Ha-Jun kicks off the falling iron chain link, closing the remaining ten feet to Belial in a microsecond.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun kicks off the falling iron chain link, closing the remaining ten feet to Belial in a microsecond.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun girte hue lohe ki chain link ko band kar deta hai, shesh das feet beleal ko ek microsecond mein band kar deta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun left bone gauntlet grabbing belial horn
panels.action: Ha-Jun's ivory bone gauntlet clamps down onto Belial's massive right ram horn with crushing grip.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's ivory bone gauntlet clamps down onto Belial's massive right ram horn with crushing grip.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki hathidant ki haddi ka gauntlet beleal ke vishal dahine mem horn ko kuchalne wali pakad se daba deta hai.

panels.shot: snapping belial horn off cleanly
panels.action: With a twist of his reinforced wrist, Ha-Jun snaps the demon lord's horn completely off at the root.
panels.prose_en: With a twist of his reinforced wrist, Ha-Jun snaps the demon lord's horn completely off at the root.
panels.prose_hi: Apni majboot kalai ko ghumakar, Ha-Jun ne rakshas swami ke seeng ko puri tarah se jad se tod diya.

panels.shot: belial screaming in humiliating agony
panels.action: Belial shrieks as black blood fountains from his cracked temple, dropping the master chain.
panels.prose_en: Belial shrieks as black blood fountains from his cracked temple, dropping the master chain.
panels.prose_hi: Beleal apne toote hue mandir se kale khoon ke favvare ke roop mein chillata hai, jisse master chain gir jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun driving fang of abyss through belial shoulder
panels.action: Ha-Jun pins Belial to the stone balcony wall, plunging the void dagger through his shoulder joint.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun pins Belial to the stone balcony wall, plunging the void dagger through his shoulder joint.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne beliyal ko patthar ki balcony ki deewar par pin kar diya, aur khali khanjar ko uske kandhe ke jod se chhed diya.

panels.shot: spatial lock freezing belial in place
panels.action: The void dagger's spatial authority locks Belial's body in frozen time and space against the wall.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Hila toh space tumhe do tukdo mein baant dega.

panels.prose_en: The void dagger's spatial authority locks Belial's body in frozen time and space against the wall.
panels.prose_hi: Shunya khanjar ka sthanik adhikar beleal ke shareer ko deewar ke samne jame hue samay aur sthan mein band kar deta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun catching the falling master chain
panels.action: Ha-Jun catches the falling black master link of the Chains of Ruin in his right hand.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun catches the falling black master link of the Chains of Ruin in his right hand.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apne dahine haath mein chains off ruin ke girte hue black master link ko pakad liya.

panels.shot: ha-jun leaping down toward tae-jun monolith
panels.action: Ha-Jun dives off the balcony, wings braking his fall as he lands atop the floating monolith.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun dives off the balcony, wings braking his fall as he lands atop the floating monolith.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun balcony se gota lagata hai, pankh uske girne ko rokte hain kyonki wah tairte hue monolith ke upar utarta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing face to face with tae-jun
panels.action: Two brothers stand inches apart: 17yo Ha-Jun and 26yo Tae-Jun, eyes locked in raw emotion.
panels.prose_en: Two brothers stand inches apart: 17-year-old Ha-Jun and 26yo Tae-Jun, eyes locked in raw emotion.
panels.prose_hi: Do bhai inch bhar ki doori par khade han: Satra saal ka Ha-Jun aur 26 varshiya Tae-Jun, aankhen kacchi bhavna mein doobi hui han.

panels.shot: tae-jun touching ha-jun cheek with trembling hand
panels.action: Tae-Jun raises his bruised, shivering hand, gently cupping his younger brother's cheek.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun... Tum itne bade ho gaye... Kitne strong ban gaye ho...

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun raises his bruised, shivering hand, gently cupping his younger brother's cheek.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun apna chotil, kaanpta hua haath uthata hai aur dheere se apne chhote bhai ke gaal ko thapthapata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun tears falling onto tae-jun chains
panels.action: Ha-Jun weeps openly, his forehead pressing against his elder brother's shoulder.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Maine aapse promise kiya tha, Bhai... Main aapko dhoondh kar rahunga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun weeps openly, his forehead pressing against his elder brother's shoulder.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun khulkar rota hai, uska matha apne bade bhai ke kandhe par dab jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun gripping the chains binding his brother
panels.action: Ha-Jun wraps his hands around the black chains binding Tae-Jun's chest and arms.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun wraps his hands around the black chains binding Tae-Jun's chest and arms.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apne hathon ko Tae-Jun ki chhati aur banhon ko bandhane wali kali janjeeron ke charon or lapet liya.

panels.shot: ha-jun channeling sovereign command into chains
panels.action: Ha-Jun commands: 'Chains of Ruin... Obey your true master! RELEASE!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: CHAINS OF RUIN... APNE SAAHAB KA HUKUM SUNO! RELEASE!!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun commands: 'Chains of Ruin... Obey your true master! RELEASE!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun aadesh deta hai: 'barbad ki janjiren... apne sacche swami ki aagya ka palan karen! mukt karna!'.

panels.shot: chains of ruin uncoiling and shattering locks
panels.action: The ancient black chains unspool with musical chimes, slipping harmlessly from Tae-Jun's body.
panels.prose_en: The ancient black chains unspool with musical chimes, slipping harmlessly from Tae-Jun's body.
panels.prose_hi: Prachin kali janjeeren sangeet ki jhankar ke saath khulti han, Tae-Jun ke shareer se hanirahit roop se fisalti han.

panels.shot: tae-jun falling forward into ha-jun arms
panels.action: Weak from seven years of stasis and torture, Tae-Jun falls forward; Ha-Jun catches him firmly.
panels.prose_en: Weak from seven years of stasis and torture, Tae-Jun falls forward; Ha-Jun catches him firmly.
panels.prose_hi: Saat saal ki sthirta aur yatna se kamjor, Tae-Jun aage gir jata hai; Ha-Jun ne use majbuti se pakad liya.

panels.shot: chains of ruin coiling obediently around ha-jun torso
panels.action: The black dimensional chains wrap obediently across Ha-Jun's chest like bandoliers of pure dark gravity.
panels.prose_en: The black dimensional chains wrap obediently across Ha-Jun's chest like bandoliers of pure dark gravity.
panels.prose_hi: Kale aayami janjeeren shuddh andhere gurutvakarshan ke bandoliors ki tarah Ha-Jun ki chhati par aagyakari roop se lapetati han.

panels.shot: system interface milestone announcement
panels.action: Golden banners unfurl in triumphant celebration.

dialogue.text:
[RELIC BONDED: CHAINS OF RUIN (RARE)]
Authority: Gravitational Binding & Dimensional Anchoring
Synchronization Rate: 50.0% (HALFWAY MILESTONE REACHED!)
All 3 Rare Relics Assembled.

panels.prose_en: Golden banners unfurl in triumphant celebration.
panels.prose_hi: Vijayi utsav mein swarn dhvaj fahrae gaye.

panels.shot: kuro landing on tae-jun shoulder greeting him
panels.action: Kuro nuzzles Tae-Jun's hair softly: 'Welcome back, Tae-Jun. Tumhara chhota bhai ab Sovereign ban chuka hai.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Dono zinda ho... First Sovereign ka bloodline complete hua.

panels.prose_en: Kuro nuzzles Tae-Jun's hair softly: 'Welcome back, Tae-Jun. Tumhara chhota bhai ab Sovereign ban chuka hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne Tae-Jun ke baalon ko dheere se thapthpaya: 'vaaps swagat hai, Tae-Jun. tumhara chhota bhai ab Sovereign ban chuka hai.'

panels.shot: ha-jun carrying tae-jun on back as wings flare
panels.action: Ha-Jun hoists his brother onto his back, 12-foot shadow wings flaring wide to escape the prison.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun hoists his brother onto his back, 12-foot shadow wings flaring wide to escape the prison.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne jail se bhagne ke liye apne bhai ko apni peeth par lahraya, 12 foot ke saaye wale pankh failaye.
